name: VariantKey
signature: public readonly record struct VariantKey(string ContentHash, string TargetId, string ProcessorId, int ProcessorVersion)

docs.summary: Identifies one processed form of one asset.
docs.remarks: Every part matters. The content hash means an edited asset misses. The target means two platforms do not evict each other. The processor id and version mean fixing a compressor invalidates only what that compressor produced, rather than forcing a full rebuild or, worse, quietly shipping stale output.

docs.summary: A filename safe form. Stable, because it is what a shared cache is addressed by.
